result.topic_en: Euler recalls finding the divisor 641 of $2^{32}+1$ while testing Fermat's claim and announces a simpler method for finding the lowest power $a^x$ for which $fa^x+g$ is divisible by a given $N$; he then states preparatory lemmas on residues of products and powers modulo $N$.
result.transcription:
244
forma $2\lambda n+1$ continentur; atque hoc principio olim fum vfus in inueftigatione numerorum primorum. Simili modo cum olim affertionem Fermatii examinaffem, qua affeuerarat, formulam $2^n+1$ femper effe numerum primum, quoties exponens $n$ fuerit ipfe poteftas binarii, quaeftionem, fupra memoratam in fubfidium vocare fum coactus, qua poft plures calculos tandem inueni, formulam $2^{32}+1$ diuiforem habere $641$; ex quo nunc quaeftio formari poteft: quaenam fit binarii poteftas infima, quae vnitate aucta fiat per $641$ diuifibilis? Methodus quidem, qua olim fum vfus, per calculos fatis taediofos procedebat; nunc autem fe mihi obtulit alia methodus multo fimplicior et expeditior, non folum hos memoratos cafus circa poteftates binarii refoluendi, fed quae adeo ad quaeftionem illam generaliffimam adplicari poffit, qua fcilicet quaeritur infima poteftas $a^x$, vt formula $fa^x+g$ per datum numerum $N$ fiat diuifibilis. Hanc ergo nouam methodum hic breuiter fum expofiturus; hunc autem in finem fequentia Lemmata funt praemittenda:

Lemma 1.
§. 3. Si numerus quicunque $A$ per alium $N$ diuifus relinquat refiduum $r$; tum etiam omnes hi numeri: $r\mp N$; $r\mp 2N$; $r\mp 3N$, et in genere $r\mp\lambda N$, aeque tanquam refidua fpectari poffunt, quandoquidem hae ipfae formulae per $N$ diuifae relinquunt $r$.

Lemma 2.
§. 4. Si numerus $A$ per diuiforem $N$ diuifus relinquat refiduum $a$, numerus vero $B$ per eundem diuifus refi-

245
duum $b$; tum productum $AB$ per $N$ diuifum relinquet refiduum $ab$. Hinc ergo poteftates $A^2$; $A^3$; $A^4$; etc. dabunt refidua $a^2$; $a^3$; $a^4$; etc., quae pro lubitu, diuifione per $N$ facta, ad minimos valores reducere licet.

Lemma 3.
§. 5. Si propofito diuifore $N$ poteftas $a^x$ refiduum det $=r$, poteftas vero $a^y$ refiduum $=s$; tum poteftas $A^{x+y}$ refiduum dabit $=rs$; vnde etiam hae poteftates $a^{2x}$; $a^{3x}$; $a^{4x}$; etc. refidua producent $r^2$; $r^3$; $r^4$; etc.

Lemma 4.
§. 6. Si vt ante pro diuifore $N$ poteftas $a^x$ praebeat refiduum $r$, poteftas vero $a^y$ refiduum $s$; hinc etiam affignari poterit refiduum refpondens poteftati $a^{x-y}$, quod quidem foret $=\frac{r}{s}$, fi $r$ per $s$ diuidi poffet. Quia autem loco $r$ fumere licet $r\mp\lambda N$, femper $\lambda$ ita definiri poterit, vt haec forma $r\mp\lambda N$ per $s$ diuidi queat, ac tum quotus dabit ipfum refiduum poteftati $a^{x-y}$ refpondens.

Lemma 5.
§. 7. Si pro diuifore $N$ poteftas $a^x$ relinquat $r$, fitque $r\mp\lambda N=a^\alpha s$, ita vt $a^\alpha s$ tanquam refiduum fpectari poffit; tum poteftas $a^{x-\alpha}$ refiduum relinquet $s$, quandoquidem diuidendum et refiduum femper per communem diuiforem deprimere licet.

Hh 3 Pro-

items.quote: quaenam fit binarii poteftas infima, quae vnitate aucta fiat per $641$ diuifibilis?
items.english: What is the lowest power of two which, increased by one, becomes divisible by 641?

items.quote: qua fcilicet quaeritur infima poteftas $a^x$, vt formula $fa^x+g$ per datum numerum $N$ fiat diuifibilis
items.english: Namely, the question in which one seeks the lowest power $a^x$ such that the formula $fa^x+g$ becomes divisible by a given number $N$.

items.quote: Hanc ergo nouam methodum hic breuiter fum expofiturus; hunc autem in finem fequentia Lemmata funt praemittenda
items.english: I shall therefore briefly set out this new method here; to this end the following lemmas must be stated first.

items.quote: tum etiam omnes hi numeri: $r\mp N$; $r\mp 2N$; $r\mp 3N$, et in genere $r\mp\lambda N$, aeque tanquam refidua fpectari poffunt
items.english: If A divided by N leaves remainder r, then all the numbers $r\mp N$, $r\mp 2N$, $r\mp 3N$, and in general $r\mp\lambda N$, may equally be regarded as remainders.

items.quote: tum productum $AB$ per $N$ diuifum relinquet refiduum $ab$
items.english: If A and B leave remainders a and b on division by N, then the product AB divided by N leaves remainder ab.
If, for the divisor N, $a^x$ leaves remainder r and $a^y$ leaves remainder s, then the power $a^{x+y}$ (printed $A^{x+y}$) gives remainder rs.

items.quote: femper $\lambda$ ita definiri poterit, vt haec forma $r\mp\lambda N$ per $s$ diuidi queat, ac tum quotus dabit ipfum refiduum poteftati $a^{x-y}$ refpondens
items.english: λ can always be determined so that $r\mp\lambda N$ is divisible by s, and then the quotient gives the remainder corresponding to the power $a^{x-y}$.
If $a^x$ leaves r and $r\mp\lambda N=a^\alpha s$, then the power $a^{x-\alpha}$ leaves remainder s.
